mapper.update:
merge into t_cx_holiday_setting a USING (
select #{STOCK.holidayName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} holiday_name, #{STOCK.holidayDay,jdbcType=DATE} holiday_day,
#{STOCK.createBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} create_by, #{STOCK.createTime,jdbcType=DATE} create_time, #{STOCK.updateBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} update_by, #{STOCK.updateTime,jdbcType=DATE} update_time, #{STOCK.remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR} remark from dual
) b ON ( a.holiday_day = b.holiday_day AND a.del_flag = '0' ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET a.holiday_name = b.holiday_name, a.update_by = b.create_by, a.update_time = sysdate, a.remark = b.remark WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (a.id, a.holiday_day, a.holiday_name, a.create_by, a.create_time,a.remark, a.del_flag) values (SEQ_PUBLIC.NEXTVAL, b.holiday_day, b.holiday_name,b.create_by, sysdate,b.remark, '0')
